name: EPIC 203130273
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 2, 12.6 solar radii and 0.97 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 203130273 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM radius (solar radii) 12.64837 (16th-84th percentiles 12.061411-13.384251), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 203130273: GALAH DR3 effective temperature 4412.139 +/- 108 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 203130273 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2620.429688 (16th-84th percentiles 2504.941406-2752.460938), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 2,620 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 0.97 solar masses and 12.6 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,412 K at its surface.
